svg.title: ArduPilot's position estimate against mocap, March 29 run
svg.desc: Distance between the robot's position as estimated by ArduPilot's EKF, fusing the optical flow sensor, and its true position from motion capture, over a 200-second run (log scale). While the robot drove 5.5 meters, the estimate stayed within 0.73 meters (mean 0.23). The robot then spun about 205 degrees in place, and the estimate ran away to 155 meters while the robot itself moved less than half a meter.
svg.text: position error vs mocap (m, log scale)
